svg.title: Engineering expertise
svg.desc: L0 Embedded Systems: Firmware, microcontrollers, hardware interfaces. L1 IoT Systems: Device fleets, telemetry, edge-to-cloud messaging. L2 Cloud Infrastructure: Provisioning, networking, deployment pipelines. L3 Distributed Systems: Event-driven services, messaging, consistency. L4 Backend Engineering: APIs, data modelling, persistence, integration. L5 Full Stack Development: Web and mobile applications, end to end
